meta.name: game-postmortem
meta.description: Run a structured post-mortem analyzing what went well, what went wrong, and extractable lessons. Pulls git history, milestone data, and retrospective notes automatically. Triggers on: "post-mortem", "project review", "what did we learn", "lessons learned", or when a major milestone or project is complete. Do NOT invoke for sprint-level retrospectives (use game-retrospective) or design reviews (use game-design-review). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析项目回顾，提炼经验教训
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队需要结构化地总结项目经验并持续改进。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically analyze project retrospectives and extract lessons learned
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs structured post-mortems to capture lessons and improve.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会引导你完成项目复盘：自动拉取 Git 提交记录、里程碑数据和回顾笔记，然后分五步分析哪些做得好、哪些出了问题，并提炼出可复用的经验教训，最终生成一份结构化的复盘报告。
howto.when: 当你完成一个重大项目或里程碑，或者说出“post-mortem”、“project review”、“what did we learn”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 我们刚发布游戏，做个项目复盘吧。
say.note: Claude 会启动完整的复盘流程。

say.text: 分析一下这个里程碑的教训。
say.note: Claude 会针对当前里程碑进行复盘。

say.text: 从这次项目中学到了什么？
say.note: Claude 会提取经验教训并生成报告。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you through a structured project post-mortem: it automatically pulls git history, milestone data, and retrospective notes, then analyzes what went well, what went wrong, and extracts actionable lessons, producing a final report.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you complete a major milestone or project, or when you say "post-mortem", "project review", "what did we learn", or similar keywords.

say_en.text: We just shipped the game, let's do a post-mortem.
say_en.note: Claude will start the full post-mortem workflow.

say_en.text: Analyze the lessons from this milestone.
say_en.note: Claude will review the current milestone.

say_en.text: What did we learn from this project?
say_en.note: Claude will extract lessons and generate a report.
